clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope — Requirements for centrifugally cast (spun) iron spigot and socket soil, waste and ventilating pipes together  with the details of the fittings and accessories. These pipes and fittings are suitable for use above ground only.

clauses.title: General Requirements
clauses.text: 2. General Requirements

clauses.title: Shall be capable of
clauses.text: 2.1 Shall be capable of being cut with the tools normally used for installation.

clauses.title: Tests
clauses.text: 3. Tests

clauses.title: Hardness
clauses.text: 3.1 Hardness — not greater than 230 HBS.

clauses.title: Soundness
clauses.text: 3.2 Soundness  — When tested for soundness by striking with a light hand hammer, shall emit a clear ringing sound.

clauses.title: Hydrostatic Test
clauses.text: 3.3 Hydrostatic Test— When hydrostatically tested at a pressure of 0.07 MPa (N/mm2) for 15 seconds the pipes and fittings shall not show any sign of leakage, sweating or other defects of any kind. The test shall be conducted after surface coating.

clauses.title: Sizes (in mm)
clauses.text: 4. Sizes (in mm) — Nominal Diameter DN, of pipes and fittings are 50, 75, 100 and 150.

clauses.title: Coating
clauses.text: 7. Coating

clauses.title: In all cases where
clauses.text: 7.1 In all cases where the coating material has a tar or similar base, it shall be smooth, tenacious and hard enough not to flow when exposed to a temperature of 65°C but not so brittle at a temperature of 0°C as to chip off when scribed lightly with a penknife.

clauses.title: Coating shall not be
clauses.text: 7.2 Coating shall not be applied to any pipe or fitting unless its surface is clean, dry and free from rust. Note— For detailed dimensions and body sketches refer to the standard.
